Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or phase (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate, heal). Name the workflow file in your answer.
B. A specific script or prompt under `scripts/` or `prompts/`. Name the file in your answer.
C. Documentation only (README.md, docs/, agents.d fragments).
D. None of the above. Describe the target in your answer. (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean for that target?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure. Give a run ID, issue, PR or error message.
B. Improve performance, cost or speed. Name the metric and the target.
C. Add or change a specific behaviour. Describe the expected outcome.
D. Close this issue as unactionable, because no concrete improvement is intended. (RECOMMENDED)
